Batch: Sysinternals Suite and independently owned product folder coexistence

Test.Filter: does not remove independently owned product files with matching names
Test.Behavior: The test resolves package.sysinternals-suite and package.sysinternals-process-explorer from the catalog, selects a member present in both packages, stages the Suite-owned copy, and verifies Suite removal removes only its copy while preserving the product-owned file.

TestCorrection: The first assertion incorrectly expected the Suite destination directory itself to disappear. Portable removal leaves an empty directory; the final regression checks that the Suite-owned member is absent and the shared product-owned member is unchanged.

SideEffects.TemporaryPayloads: Synthetic one-member ZIP and product fixture under .local

Resolved: Symmetric Suite-to-product folder ownership preservation is covered by a focused synthetic regression; the reverse product-to-Suite direction remains covered by SysinternalsProductPackages.Tests.ps1.
Excluded: Defender-detected utilities remain excluded separately; no utility was executed.
Deferred: Whole-Suite Windows target support, actual utility behavior/activation and feature acceptance remain pending.
MigrationAccounting.LicenseDisposition: Prior RIDE v2 specialist approval governs direct Microsoft download-and-install; no legal or generalized redistribution gate applies.
